verdict.rationale: Evidence shows GitHub has a well-documented REST/GraphQL API with fine-grained permission scopes (github-docs-18, github-docs-19) and an official CLI/MCP server (github-probe-3, github-probe-4), suggesting broad API coverage, but nothing explicitly confirms full UI/API feature parity, and the probe for a discoverable OpenAPI spec at expected locations failed (github-probe-2). Missing for 10: explicit documentation or claim of complete UI-to-API parity, and independent confirmation that all UI actions have API equivalents.
